articles.title: Latent Telepathy: Multi-Robot Communication with Self-Supervised Perceptual Latents
articles.summary: In a decentralized multi-robot team under partial observability, the fact that decides a robot's next action is often visible only to a teammate. Each robot broadcasts the perceptual latent vector it already computes for its own use, the output of an encoder trained with a self-supervised joint-embedding predictive objective, frozen, and shared across the team.
